text: Three mistakes account for most wrong answers in this topic. Mistake 1: Deciding the rule from a single letter. If C becomes D, the rule might be +1. But it might also be a pattern like +1, +2, +3 across positions. Always confirm with every letter. Mistake 2: Ignoring the circular alphabet. Y plus 2 is not position 27. It wraps around to A. Subtract 26 whenever you go past Z. Mistake 3: Mixing up the direction when decoding. If coding means +2, then decoding means −2. Under time pressure, candidates often apply the coding rule again instead of reversing it.
